title: Greenhouse
html:
Greenhouse

The Greenhouse is a Garden Plot unlocked at Garden Level VII (7). It is accessed after completing the Carpenter's offer as a Garden Visitor and obtaining the  Greenhouse Blueprint.

Overview

[edit | edit source]

While in the Greenhouse, players can grow different crops and water them. They will grow while offline and can be harvested once mature, granting special Crop Effects. All crops have unique buffs, and some even have negative effects.

These buffs are as follows:

  • Harvest Boost - Increases Yield by +20%
  • Improved Harvest Boost - Increases Yield by +30%
  • XP Boost - Increases Farming XP of adjacent crops by +20%
  • Improved XP Boost - Increases Farming XP of adjacent crops by +30%
  • Water Retain - Retains watering status of adjacent crops by +50%
  • Improved Water Retain - Retains watering status of adjacent crops by +100%
  • Immunity - Provides Immunity to negative effects.
  • Effect Spread - Spreads other buffs and debuffs on the current crop to adjacent crops.
  • Bonus Drops - Harvested items additionally roll from an extra loot pool.
  • Harvest Loss - Decreases Yield by -20%
  • XP Loss - Reduces Farming XP of adjacent crops by -20%
  • Water Drain - Reduces watering status of nearby crops by -30%

Harvesting crops with the Bonus Drops effect in the Greenhouse rolls for Harvest Bounty, which can drop one of the following items:[1]

Growth Stage

[edit | edit source]

Crops and Mutations in your Greenhouse grow in set Growth Stages. The timer can be seen when inspecting a growing crop or mutation with the Plant Diagnostic Tool.

Growth Stages start out taking 4 hours baseline, and can be improved by:

  • +5-50% - Greenhouse Growth Speed Upgrades
  • +2.5-30% - Planting all 12 unique crop types in ANY Greenhouse plot (other plots will also be affected)
  • Increasing your Crop Growth stat (0-200)

When all of these bonuses are applied, the Growth Stage timer will be reduced to 1h 44m 20s.

The formula for Growth Stage timer in seconds is:

T=144001+0.025c+0.0025g+{0.05uif 0≤u≤80.50if u=9

Where c is the # of Unique Crops, g is your Crop Growth stat, and u is your Greenhouse Growth Speed Upgrade.

Water Level

[edit | edit source]

After each growth stage, a crop loses between 2-3 Water Level, which can be mitigated by the +50% Water Retain and +100% Improved Water Retain effects, and amplified by the -30% Water Drain negative effect respectively.

If a crop has negative Water Level during a Growth Stage, it has a chance not to advance to the next stage.

Yield

[edit | edit source]

In addition to  Farming Fortune, the base crops given when harvesting crops in the Greenhouse are also affected by various Yield buffs:

Icon Modifier Buff
Plant Yield Greenhouse Upgrade +2-20% Greenhouse Plant Yield
Evergreen Chip +2-60% more base Greenhouse crops
Harvest Boost +20% Yield (applied to adjacent crops)

Effects on a crop are locked to what they were when it first became harvestable.

Improved Harvest Boost +30% Yield (applied to adjacent crops)

Overrides Harvest Boost. Effects on a crop are locked to what they were when it first became harvestable.

Unique Greenhouse Crop Bonus +3% Yield per unique non-mutated crop growing in any Greenhouse plot.

Gives +36% Yield with all 12 unique crop types.

Mutations

[edit | edit source]
Main article: Mutations

Mutations have a chance to grow in the Greenhouse when specific crops are arranged in specific patterns. They can be analyzed in the Crop Analyzer.

Upon harvesting a Mutation, one has a chance to drop an  Ethereal Vine, which is used to unlock more crop slots in the Greenhouse. Once all crop slots are unlocked, they can also be used to unlock a 2nd and 3rd Greenhouse.

Greenhouse Skins

[edit | edit source]
Main article: Greenhouse Skins

Greenhouse Skins are a type of cosmetic that changes the look of the Greenhouse. They can be applied to the Greenhouse at the Desk.
